notes.sowing: Plant seed potatoes, whole or cut into pieces with two or three eyes, {cm:10} to {cm:15} deep, from 4 weeks before your last frost up to the frost date, once the soil is at least {c:10}. Sprouting them in a bright, cool room for 4 to 6 weeks first gives an earlier crop.
notes.care: Earth up when shoots reach about {cm:23}, leaving the tips showing, and repeat every few weeks until the ridge is {cm:20} to {cm:30} high: exposed tubers turn green and toxic. Cover new shoots if frost is forecast. Water about {cm:2.5} a week.
notes.harvest: Dig new potatoes 7 to 8 weeks after planting, around flowering. For storage, wait until the tops die back, cure at {c:15} to {c:18} for 10 days, then store cool and dark.
